sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dressed to Kill is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Good day to you! Everybody’s so stylish nowadays, folks come by asking for things that weren’t much of a hit even back in peaceful times. Doesn’t matter if the thing is hit through by PM like paper, they’ll still take it as long as it makes them stand out. It turns out, people are still having a life, want to party or whatever. Look for different kinds of hats on mannequins or shelves, you know, those like in western movies, and grab our ushankas too."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find the item in raid: 2 Kinda cowboy hat
- Hand over the items
- Find the item in raid: 2 any Ushanka hat
- Hand over the items

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Beauty will save the world, as they say. Thank you, really helped me out, brother. The hats are gonna be sold in just one day, trust me. Here, take this as a reward."
